notes: Both compounds fuse correctly with head genus only (the noun modifiers `autumn` and `storm` are rightly not exposed), the inanimate transitive subject takes `Agent`, definite singulars get witnesses, and the bare present correctly gets no status atom. `Patient` on 'the storm season' follows the occurrence-object rule, though the Inception section gives a begun activity `Theme` plus `Ongoing` -- the boundary for `begin` with an event-denoting NP object rather than a to-V complement is not settled in the text.
